title: Build a Level
goal: A level is a layout of blocks, coins, and bad guys.
mascot_lines: A level is one chunk of a game — a single screen or stage.
Levels usually get harder as you go, and they each teach you one new thing.
Beating a tough level feels really, really good.
Good levels are how we keep a game feeling fresh from start to finish.

tier2.rephrase: Order the steps to build a fun level.

tier3.nudge: First make the floor. Then add stuff. Then test. Then fix what is too hard!

payload.prompt: Paint your own level! Pick tiles, click to place. Save to finish.
